SCAN — unsupervised anomaly detection over fused geometric lenses
post.description: Zero-config anomaly detection. Auto-introspects the schema and fuses up to seven geometric lenses (global curvature, contextual curvature, velocity, text, relational, completion, density) into a per-record score with per-lens attribution. Records come back sorted most-anomalous first.

budget.description: Review fraction — the top `budget` share of records is marked `flagged`.

weights.description: Optional lens-name -> weight map for supervised linear fusion (see /scan/fit). Absent -> lenses fuse by max.

exclude.description: Fields to keep out of the geometry — e.g. an outcome column that would leak.

lenses.description: Lens names actually built for this bundle.

message.description: Present when the scan had nothing to say (empty bundle, or every lens flat).

items.description: The bundle's base-key field appears under its own name (e.g. `txn_id`), alongside these keys.

422.description: Refused — `error` names the field and the requirement it missed

post.summary: SCAN/FIT — learn supervised lens weights from a labeled field
post.description: Trains a class-weighted logistic regression over SCAN's per-record lens features. Returns the weights (feed them back to `POST /scan` as `weights`) alongside a held-out k-fold PR-AUC and the unsupervised max-fusion baseline it has to beat.

label_field.description: A 0/1, boolean, or yes/no field marking confirmed positives.

200.description: Learned weights and the held-out comparison

pr_auc_supervised_heldout.description: k-fold held-out PR-AUC of the learned weights.

note.description: Warns when there are too few positives for the fold count to mean much.

weights.description: Lens-name -> weight. Pass this object straight to `POST /scan`.

422.description: Refused — `error` names the field and the requirement it missed

post.summary: CLUSTER — spectral / k-means / GMM / DBSCAN clustering plus embedding
post.description: Clusters records over the standardized numeric fibers. `spectral` embeds in the bottom-k Laplacian eigenspace of the kNN graph before fitting the head — that is the geometric arm. `kmeans`, `gmm`, and `dbscan` are the flat control arm.

eps.description: DBSCAN neighborhood radius. Omitted -> auto-estimated from the data.

restarts.description: k-means / gmm-init restarts, lowest-inertia wins. Omitted -> adaptive.

embed_dim.description: Spectral: eigenvectors to embed with. Omitted -> k.

head.description: Spectral: which head to fit IN the eigenspace.

exclude.description: Fields to drop from the geometry (id or label columns).

200.description: Cluster labels, sizes, and per-record coordinates

n_noise.description: DBSCAN points assigned to no cluster.

eigenvalues.description: Spectral: the Laplacian eigenvalues used for the embedding.

items.description: The bundle's base-key field appears under its own name, alongside these keys.

cluster.description: null = DBSCAN noise, i.e. no cluster — not cluster -1.

coords.description: Embedding coordinates (spectral eigenmap, or soft responsibilities for gmm).

422.description: Refused — `error` names the field and the requirement it missed

post.summary: INFER — supervised prediction, filling a missing target
post.description: Regression when `target` is numeric, classification when it is categorical. Scores on held-out folds against a flat baseline, then fills `target` for the records that are missing it.

target.description: Field to predict. Numeric -> regression, categorical -> classification.

method.description: Regression: diffusion | local_linear | knn | ols | gp. Classification: diffusion | knn | svm.

folds.description: Cross-validation folds for the held-out score.

exclude.description: Extra fields to drop from the feature set.

200.description: Held-out score, baseline, and the filled predictions

baseline.description: Same shape as `metric`, for the flat kNN-mean / majority-class control.

items.description: One object per record that was missing `target`: the base-key field under its own name, and the predicted value under the `target` field's name.

422.description: Refused — `error` names the field and the requirement it missed

post.summary: REDUCE — PCA dimensionality reduction
post.description: Top-k eigenvectors of the standardized-feature covariance. Returns the loadings, each record's reduced coordinates, the explained-variance ratios, and the reconstruction error.

whiten.description: Rescale each component to unit variance.

exclude.description: Fields to drop from the feature set.

loadings.description: Feature name -> loading on this component.

items.description: The bundle's base-key field appears under its own name, alongside `coords`.

422.description: Refused — `error` names the field and the requirement it missed

post.summary: FACTORIZE — recommender matrix factorization over (user, item, rating)
post.description: Learns rank-k latent user/item factors plus global mean and per-user/item biases by regularized SGD, then fills the ratings that are missing. Reports held-out RMSE against the global-mean baseline.

rating.description: Numeric field with the observed rating.

reg.description: L2 regularization on factors and biases.

200.description: Fit quality and the filled ratings

n_ratings.description: Observed (user, item, rating) triples used for the fit.

baseline_rmse.description: Global-mean baseline — the number `rmse` has to beat.

items.description: One object per record with a missing rating: the base-key field under its own name, and the predicted value under the `rating` field's name.

422.description: Refused — `error` names the field and the requirement it missed

post.summary: CHANGEPOINTS — time-series regime-shift detection
post.description: Orders the records into a series and slides a two-window two-sample t-statistic across it; non-max-suppressed peaks above `threshold` are regime shifts. Detection only — GIGI does not forecast.

value.description: Numeric field to monitor. Omitted -> all numeric fibers except the time field.

time.description: Field to order the series by. Omitted -> a time-named numeric fiber, else record order.

window.description: Sliding-window half-width, and the minimum segment length.

threshold.description: Detection threshold on the t-statistic. Lower = more sensitive.

max_changepoints.description: Cap on returned changepoints, strongest first. 0 = all.

time_field.description: null when the series fell back to record order.

time.description: The `time_field` value at that position, rendered as a string.

statistic.description: The two-sample t-statistic at the peak.

field.description: The field that moved most at this changepoint.

422.description: Refused — `error` names the field and the requirement it missed

post.summary: PRESCRIBE — read the data's geometric shape and suggest what to try
post.description: A diagnostic, not a prediction. Measures curvature, the intrinsic/ambient dimension ratio, and spectral clarity, then names the methods worth trying. Makes no performance claim.

sample.description: Stride cap on points used for the O(n^2) probes.

exclude.description: Numeric fibers to leave out of the fingerprint.

200.description: The geometric fingerprint, with plain-English reads

features.description: Fibers that went into the fingerprint.

recommendations.description: Methods worth trying — suggestions, not scores.

422.description: Refused — `error` names the field and the requirement it missed

post.summary: CIRCULATION — split a directed flow into ranking plus irreducible loops
post.description: Hodge-decomposes a directed weighted flow into the part a global potential (a ranking) explains and the circulation no ranking can — loops, rings. `magnetic_gap` is the Hermitian-Laplacian flux witness that undirected diffusion is blind to.

source.description: Categorical field naming each edge's source node.

target.description: Categorical field naming each edge's target node.

weight.description: Numeric field for the directed flow value. Omitted -> 1.0 per edge.

charge.description: Magnetic charge — flux sensitivity of the Hermitian Laplacian.

max_cycles.description: How many top cyclic edges to return.

200.description: The ranking, the circulation ratio, and the top cyclic edges

circulation_ratio.description: Fraction of flow energy no ranking explains. 0 = perfectly rankable, 1 = pure circulation.

magnetic_gap.description: Smallest eigenvalue of the normalized magnetic Laplacian at `charge`.

potential.description: The node's score in the gradient part. Sorted high to low.

residual.description: Flow left unexplained by the ranking — the cyclic part.

422.description: Refused — `error` names the field and the requirement it missed

post.summary: SOLVE — SVD fit store: the whole ridge path with exact leave-one-out
post.description: One thin SVD of the standardized design matrix, then every ridge fit on the path is a spectral filter on that cached frame — no descent, no refit. Leave-one-out is exact via the hat diagonal (Golub-Heath-Wahba 1979). Exact for the quadratic class; a preconditioner for GLMs.

alphas.description: Explicit ridge path. Empty -> a log-spaced path is auto-generated.

exclude.description: Numeric fibers to leave out of the design matrix.

200.description: The ridge path, the selected alpha, and the coefficients

rank.description: Numerical rank of the design matrix.

loo_rmse.description: Exact leave-one-out RMSE at this alpha.

coefficients.description: Feature name -> coefficient at `best_alpha`, on standardized features.

422.description: Refused — `error` names the field and the requirement it missed

post.summary: TEXTURE — how rough is one ordered signal (self-similarity exponent)
post.description: Shape verb, grid-free. Fits the structure function across lags to get the self-similarity (Hurst) exponent: >0.5 persistent, 0.5 random walk, <0.5 anti-persistent. Reads RECORD ORDER, never a timestamp, so there is no bin width to choose. Check `r_squared` — a low fit means the signal is not self-similar and `exponent` should not be read as one number. Needs at least 64 records.

field.description: Numeric field to measure. Base or fiber.

order.description: Field to order the series by. Omitted -> record order. Ordinal: only the sort matters, values are ignored.

q.description: Moment order for the structure function.

max_lag.description: Largest gap. Omitted -> n/8, which keeps every lag well-sampled.

200.description: The exponent, its fit quality, and the verdict

n.description: Records that contributed a finite value.

r_squared.description: Fit quality of the log-log structure function. Read this before reading `exponent`.

h_sd.description: Sampling sd of `exponent` at this n. The verdict band is 0.5 +/- 2*h_sd, so it widens on shorter series. Empirical law 0.29*n^-0.267, fitted to simulation.

order_field.description: null when the series used record order.

422.description: Refused — `error` names the field and the requirement it missed

post.summary: PRECEDENCE — which of two ordered fields moves first
post.description: Shape verb, grid-free. The normalised Levy area (the level-2 antisymmetric signature term) of the joint path: `area` > 0 means x leads y, and swapping the arguments negates it exactly. Reads RECORD ORDER, so the answer is invariant to any order-preserving change of clock. Needs at least 32 records.

x.description: First numeric field. Base or fiber.

y.description: Second numeric field. Must differ from `x`.

order.description: Field to order the records by. Omitted -> record order.

200.description: The signed area and which field leads

area.description: Normalised Levy area. Sign carries the direction; swapping x and y negates it.

p_value.description: Permutation p-value from a rotation null built on this data. `area` alone cannot separate a real lead from noise.

null_sd.description: Spread of that null. NOT a constant: it swings ~160x with how rough the data is.

significant.description: p_value <= 0.05. False means this window cannot establish a lead; it does not mean there is none.

null_n.description: Records the null was built from.

order_field.description: null when the series used record order.

422.description: Refused — `error` names the field and the requirement it missed

post.summary: CADENCE — is a timestamped stream arriving steadily or in bursts
post.description: Shape verb over an arrival process. Returns two numbers, always: `index` (Greenwood dispersion) and `memory` (lag-1 autocorrelation of log gaps). Both, because `index` is symmetric in the gaps and provably cannot see ordering — a high `index` alone is NOT clustering. Verdict bands are the memoryless null plus or minus 2sd, from a closed form at your n. Needs at least 64 distinct timestamps.

time.description: Numeric timestamp field. CARDINAL — the values are the entire content, not a sort key. A row index is refused by name.

block.description: Gaps per block for the drift-filtered form. Omitted -> 64.

200.description: Dispersion and memory, each with its verdict

n_events.description: Usable events after coalescing duplicate stamps.

index.description: Greenwood dispersion. <1 = more regular than random.

index_z.description: Standard deviations from the memoryless null.

index_blocked.description: Mean per-block `index`, filtering out structure longer than one block. NULL when there were under two blocks — genuinely absent, not 0.0.

verdict.description: THROTTLED means more regular than random — suspect something metering the feed.

422.description: Refused — `error` names the field and the requirement it missed

get.summary: ML catalog — every ML endpoint, its knobs, and what it does
get.description: Discovery index for the ML family. Lists each route with its parameters and a one-line description, plus which methods are geometric and which are the flat control arm. Machine-readable; no bundle required.

kind.description: Whether the method is geometric, a flat baseline, or both.

gql.description: The equivalent GQL statement, where one exists.

not_a_fit.description: Problem classes GIGI deliberately does not address, and why.
